# spotlight_workspace (Resource)

A Spotlight workspace, owned by whoever creates it. Import it by its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spotlight_workspace" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
  slug = "acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) What the workspace is called.
- `slug` (String) Where the workspace lives in the web app. It is fixed for the workspace's life, so changing it replaces the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Names the resource within its workspace, as in `acme`.
- `id` (String) Issued by Spotlight when the workspace is created, and never changed.
- `version` (Number) Rises with every change to the workspace; each write sends it back so a change made since is not overwritten.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = spotlight_workspace.acme
  id = "acme"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A workspace is imported by its slug.
terraform import spotlight_workspace.acme acme
```
